agent.rationale: Three-route incremental migration with auth, masked credentials, ETag concurrency, copy safety, and browser-test requirements.

decomposition.rationale: Shared route registration, admin navigation, and one acceptance/verification loop make the three surfaces an integrated issue-sized task.

agent_application.execution: Main agent owns OpenSpec, implementation, integration, tests, GitHub Project sync, push, and PR. Beauvoir performed a read-only survey of platform-connection contracts; no implementation work was delegated.

delegation_fallback.availability_evidence: The repository workflow records Astra as unavailable; the current host inventory and delegation tool expose gpt-6.1-sol with high effort.
delegation_fallback.reason: Use the available Sol reviewer profile without changing the coordinator profile or assigning write access.

agent_application.authorization: Existing user authorization covers incremental migration, board transitions, branch push, and a Ready-for-review PR. No merge, deployment, production change, or external-provider call is authorized.

notes: The recommendation is advisory and does not replace tests or authorization.
No raw secrets or production data were sent to TypeSafe.
